title: Inside .claude/worktrees/, the guard refuses an agent's git worktree add unless the target is its recorded home or its own agent-<id>-<suffix> red-run folder
why: The incident tree .claude/worktrees/agent-a38387a49922752ec-red (lane fix-check-round-lines, 03:57 CST Nov 8) was a sanctioned test-author red run: agent a38387a49922752ec, a test-author, made its own red-run folder, as agents/test-author.md says. guard.py hand_made_worktree_hit still lets an agent add a tree inside .claude/worktrees/ under a sibling's id or a non-agent name.
note: Coordinator pick a, 06:17 CST Nov 8: the step text is rewritten to match. Closes only the sibling-id and non-agent-name forms; reuses _own_red_run and agent_worktree_home. Red cases first (test-author, head e6e311abe). Doing in lane [ended:lane-agent-worktree-add-in-tool-dir] (lane, 06:25 CST Nov 8). Not covered by guard-relative-write-escape. Sighting (lane fail-record-ancestor-head, 06:45 CST Nov 8): .claude/worktrees/ also holds agent-a2b3554317c88e10c-red and agent-a2b3554317c88e10c-red2, from an agent that lane cannot trace. Both fit the own red-run form agent-<id>-<suffix>, so they may be allowed; the lane checks them against agent_worktree_home. Sighting (lane lane-lint-hook-suites, 07:00 CST Nov 8): the other-checkout guard refused a test-author's Edit inside its own red-run checkout (.claude/worktrees/agent-<id>-red), though the test-author role text allows writes there. Check the write side of _own_red_run too. Detail (lane lane-lint-hook-suites, 07:50 CST Nov 8): the guard disagrees with itself. The test-author's Edit to its own agent-<id>-red checkout was refused ('writes limited to that folder'), while the same write through Bash (a cd there plus a scratch helper) passed; hooks/guard.py has no red-checkout rule, so either the Edit refusal is a false alarm or the Bash route is a hole. The fix makes both routes give one verdict. Sighting (Lane bg-tail-loses-verdict ([ended:Lane:-bg-tail-loses-verdict]), 16:58 CST Nov 8, during #2291): the guard allowed `git worktree add` to a `$S` variable path three times, then refused a literal path. A variable target goes around the hand-made-worktree check. Sighting (lane bg-tail-loses-verdict, 22:42 CST Nov 8): a record-writer agent hit the hand-made-worktree refusal plus an EnterWorktree cwd error when it tried a fresh tree, and used its launch worktree instead.
